rules.message: `any` switches off type checking (SC-TYPE). Type the value: `unknown` plus a zod or class-validator parse at the edge, or a named interface/type. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>`, only where a third-party library signature forces `any`; a payload is typed `unknown` and parsed, never waived.

@ts-ignore and @ts-nocheck hide real type errors (SC-IGNORE). Fix the type; if a suppression is truly needed use `// @ts-expect-error <reason>` on the one line, which fails when the error disappears. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-IGNORE <reason>`, only for generated files or a third-party typing bug you link to.

process.env read outside the config module (SC-ENV). Read and validate environment variables once in the config/env module (for example src/config or env.ts) and inject or import the typed value. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-ENV <reason>`, only in bootstrap code that runs before the config module can load.

Hardcoded URL (SC-CONST). Environment URLs belong in the config/env module; a top-level UPPER_CASE constant is only for fixed protocol identifiers (an XML namespace, a schema URI). Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-CONST <reason>`.
